idea-plugin.name: SchemaToUML
idea-plugin.description:
SchemaToUML - Fast ERD generator for Laravel

Instant, offline and private UML & Mermaid ERD generation directly from your Laravel migrations to your clipboard.

Features:

  • Zero Configuration: 100% local static analysis, no third-party APIs or external AI required.
  • Batch Directory Processing: Right-click any migration folder (e.g. database/migrations) to document entire database schemas at once.
  • Automated Relationship Mapping: Infers and draws table connections (Foreign Keys, constrained(), and Laravel conventions).
  • Detailed Metadata: Extracts primary keys (PK), foreign keys (FK), composite unique constraints, default values, and column lengths.
  • Mermaid.js & Draw.io Ready: Generates clean syntax compatible with Mermaid Live Editor, Draw.io, GitHub, and Notion.

☕ Support the project: If SchemaToUML saves you time documenting schemas, consider buying me a coffee on Ko-fi to support continuous maintenance and new features!

Generador rápido y offline de diagramas Mermaid ERD directamente desde esquemas y migraciones de Laravel al portapapeles.
